■ Stage Direction
Same character as "Townsperson A (Male)" in Episode 3.

★Request
King Halo and Special Week walk into frame

You worked hard today too, Urara-chan.
I'll give you a carrot as a present later!

Okaay! Trainer, you watch too, okay?
Alright, here I gooo!

Heartened by Haru Urara's earnest spirit,
the crowd cheered frantically for her in the race.

Yep, leave it to me!
I'll show you I can get 1st place!
Run at full power until the very end!
My tummy feels heavy from eating too much, but I'm okay!
Urara-chaaan! Go, gooo!!

I helped you with your training, after all,
so make sure you produce proper results.

It doesn't seem like she's holding back... not at all!
She's running with all her might, but the gap with the front runners just isn't closing!
Yes, precisely because she ran her heart out to the very end without giving up.
Remember...? Okay, got it!

That's why so many people are drawn to her.
...And without a doubt, I was one of them too.

"Debut Race 3 is about to begin.
All participating runners, please assemble at the starting paddock."

Haru Urara finished her Debut Race
in 9th place out of 10 runners.

'Cause I worked super hard in training,
and ate tons and tooons of carrots!
Oh, so this is where you were.

If I can debut in the Twinkle Series,
I'll get to run in tons of different races!

Good luck, Urara-chan!
If you just remember what you learned in training, I'm sure you'll do great!

King-chan and Spe-chan!
You came to watch!

The leader crosses the finish line now!
And the trailing pack surges across right after!
Urara-chan, we came to cheer you on!
Do your best!!

Really?! Yay!!
Now I can do my best for the next race!

Congratulations, Urara-chan!
That was a fantastic race!

It's finally time.
I don't feel like I'm gonna lose at all today!

To keep losing, yet keep pressing forward with your head held high
is no easy feat.
And so, our challenge alongside the endlessly bright and optimistic Haru Urara had begun.
Ah, it's my turn!
You never know what'll happen in a race until the very end, right?!
You don't need to remember *those* things!
Huh?! You'll train with me again?

Eeeh?! You're gonna scout me?!
For real for real?!

Like Spe-chan secretly eating snacks,
or Spe-chan tripping on the muddy track, right?!
The day of the Debut Race—

But you know, I feel like I can get 1st place next time!
Aah, I can't wait for the next Debut Race~.

Then I'm counting on you, Trainer!
I'll show you I can get tons of 1st places!!
The field is already stringing out, and bringing up the rear is Haru Urara.

Yay!!
I get to run in the Twinkle Series!!
Ehehe, 9th place! 9th place! Yay!
Scout...?

And then, maybe I'll get lots of 1st places too!
Ooh~ I can't wait!!
Awesome, so awesome!! It's my first time getting 9th place!!
And with that, Haru Urara's Debut Race finally got underway.

No matter how many times she lost, Haru Urara never gave up and kept working hard with a smile...
Her finishing place was...

The Umamusume aiming for the Twinkle Series
sprint across the dirt track.
Do your best! Urara-chaaan!
And then—

The Debut Race is all over, huh.
That was so much fun~.
